channel.title: mint - companies
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: Anthropic IPO windfall: Over 5,000 employees become millionaires; 600 join the $100 million club
item.description: Anthropic's record IPO has turned an estimated 5,100 employees into millionaires, with nearly 600 holding equity worth over $100 million. The windfall could boost San Francisco's housing market and charitable giving.

item.title: Anthropic IPO raises $81 billion at $1.75 trillion valuation: Numbers that explain the record listing
item.description: Anthropic raised a record $81 billion in its IPO, surpassing SpaceX’s $75 billion listing. Shares surged over 30% on debut, briefly valuing the Claude maker at $2.01 trillion before closing at $1.75 trillion. Its co-founders, employees and early investors stand to gain substantially.

item.title: Anthropic shares jump 21% after $107.3 billion IPO breaks record
item.description: Anthropic PBC shares soared 21% above their IPO price after the artificial intelligence lab’s blockbuster $107.3 billion debut broke SpaceX’s record for the biggest-ever offering.

item.title: Motilal Oswal Alternates to raise up to ₹3,000 crore for maiden office fund
item.description: It will focus on early-stage investments and partner with property developers through equity joint ventures in Grade A office developments across Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Mumbai, the National Capital Region, Pune and Chennai.

item.title: Paytm returns to wallet business, will it help regain some of its lost markets?
item.description: A licence to restart its digital wallet business could help Paytm reclaim payment transactions and improve margins, but UPI's dominance makes a revival harder.

item.title: Canadas BMO returning to US oil and gas investment banking, sources say
item.description: BMO-USA/ENERGY (EXCLUSIVE, PIX):EXCLUSIVE-Canada's BMO returning to US oil and gas investment banking, sources say

item.title: Skydance, ESPN Opt Out of Bidding for FIFA World Cup Rights
item.description: Skydance Corp. and Walt Disney Co.’s ESPN have declined to bid for the US media rights for the next FIFA Men’s World Cup tournament in what could be one of the costliest and competitive auctions in the global soccer event’s history, according to people familiar with the matter.

item.title: Anthropic IPO jackpot! CEO Dario Amodei's 237.3 million shares at $83 apiece now carry a $19.7 billion valuation
item.description: The surge in Anthropic's share price also highlights the wealth created for its early investors and founders as the company completed what became the largest IPO in history, raising approximately $81.34 billion.

item.title: As Anthropic IPO debuts, founders see AI accelerating medical breakthroughs, transforming lives
item.description: As Anthropic makes its stock market debut, co-founders Dario and Daniela Amodei highlight how AI could accelerate medical research, reshape workplaces and improve everyday lives, while stressing the need for responsible development.

item.title: Who is Alok Bansal? Here’s why the PB Fintech co-founder is stepping down as executive vice-chairman
item.description: Who is Alok Bansal? The Policybazaar co-founder will step down as PB Fintech's executive vice-chairman in March 2027. Here's why and what comes next.

item.title: India biodiesel blending target: Why actual levels remain at just 0.08% despite 2030 goal
item.description: The availability of sufficient raw materials remains a key factor in determining how quickly India can expand its biodiesel blending programme and move closer to its 2030 target.

item.title: Anthropic IPO windfall: More than 400 employees could be worth over ₹935 crore each
item.description: Anthropic's $1.5 trillion IPO could make the average employee worth over ₹370 crore, with 400 early staff potentially becoming multimillionaires.

item.title: Disney plans $3 billion cost cuts by 2029, warns of more layoffs despite strong quarterly results
item.description: Disney CFO Hugh Johnston, as per CNBC report, indicated “we do expect more layoffs” as the company pursues its cost-reduction target. However, the company has not disclosed how many employees could be affected or when the layoffs would take place.

item.title: Anthropic is not a safe AI company? Nobel laureates accuse Claude maker of abandoning promises ahead of IPO
item.description: Nobel laureates and leading AI experts accuse Anthropic of putting its race for AI dominance ahead of safety commitments as it makes its stock market debut.

item.title: Kay Beauty bags top honour at PETA India 2026 Awards: All you need to know about Katrina Kaif's ₹350 cr beauty brand
item.description: Kay Beauty, co-founded by Nykaa, and actor Katrina Kaif, was launched in 2019. The brand recently launched a skincare line.

item.title: Anthropic’s $81 billion IPO creates a massive payday, but employees face an unusual hurdle before cashing in
item.description: Anthropic’s $81 billion IPO promises a massive payday for employees, but strict stock-selling rules could make cashing in more complicated.

item.title: Who is Jaan Tallinn? Meet Skype co-founder who fears AI could end humanity but may make billions from Anthropic’s IPO
item.description: Jaan Tallinn, Skype co-founder and AI safety advocate, could make billions from Anthropic's IPO after leading its first $124 million funding round.

item.title: Ashton Kutcher struck AI gold? Actor founded Sound Ventures’ Anthropic bet now worth $7B as AI firm goes public today
item.description: Could Ashton Kutcher become a billionaire? His early bet on Anthropic is paying off as the Claude maker prepares to go public at a $1.5 trillion valuation.

item.title: Subhash Chandra insolvency: Responses served to stakeholders as creditor dispute continues
item.description: The NCLT has given the CBI three weeks to file its reply, while creditors continue to contest the admission of claims by five entities that helped secure approval for Chandra’s ₹6.5 crore repayment plan.

item.title: Bank of America arm signs ₹1,450 crore Hyderabad office lease
item.description: BA Continuum India has leased 1 million sq. ft at Mindspace Cyberabad for 12 years, as global capability centres drive demand for large office campuses in Hyderabad.

item.title: “A lot of healthcare doesn't need a hospital”: How Nirav Bajaj plans to reshape medical care with Nivara
item.description: Bajaj Group is entering healthcare through its Nivara brand, with a Pune medical centre opening soon and a planned 500-bed hospital. BIHS will initially invest ₹2,000–2,500 crore and aims to expand into at least six cities over the next decade.

item.title: The mystery 31% shareholder towering over Deepinder Goyal’s Temple
item.description: Deepinder Goyal’s ₹1,715-crore wearable startup Temple has attracted India’s marquee investors. Yet corporate filings reveal a silent figure holding a bigger stake than Goyal himself. Behind the ₹85,000 device lies an intriguing trail.

item.title: Mint Explainer | Why are Indian IT companies bleeding brand value?
item.description: A report by consumer insights firm Kantar shows IT majors TCS, Infosys, Wipro and others have lost upwards of 40% of their brand value in 2026.

item.title: India’s top 10 brands lose collective value as Airtel claims top spot, Meesho rises fastest
item.description: In its annual ranking of India’s most valuable brands, Kantar said brand value of the top 10 fell collectively by 16%. Telecom provider Airtel claimed the top spot while value e-commerce platform Meesho rose the fastest to claim the 59th spot.

item.title: Nvidia's China troubles deepen? Muddy Waters flags ex- No 3 Jay Puri's alleged Supermicro links
item.description: Nvidia faces fresh scrutiny over former executive Jay Puri's alleged China links after Muddy Waters raises questions about Supermicro and chip shipments.

item.title: Meta looks to appoint public policy chief in India amid growing friction with Modi government: Report
item.description: Social media platforms have also come under increased scrutiny for their role in public discourse and political mobilisation, particularly among younger users. They have emerged as important tools for Gen Z-led anti-government protests this year.

item.title: Ambuja Neotia to invest about ₹2,700 crore in hotels, almost triple room capacity
item.description: The Kolkata-based group plans to add capacity to its hotels business, largely in eastern India, while expanding its partnership with IHCL and building an asset-light boutique hotel business through Tree of Life.

item.title: Who is Krishna Rao? Meet the low-profile Indian-origin CFO behind Anthropic IPO - Biggest AI listing soon
item.description: Anthropic CFO Krishna Rao has helped guide the company’s rapid growth, fundraising and IPO while balancing investor expectations with its commitment to safe AI.&nbsp;

item.title: Finally, data spoke what all felt! 64% of Indian employees report working extra, unpaid hours; who is taking max burden?
item.description: A survey across 36 markets found that 64% of Indian workers put in at least six unpaid hours weekly, while 24% work 16 hours or more per week. Longer unpaid hours have raised concerns about employee well-being and retention.

item.title: KKR picks up minority stake in Gentari’s India renewables business
item.description: The investment will provide growth capital to Gentari’s India platform, which has about 8 GW of operating, under-construction and contracted renewable energy capacity.

item.title: 'Not a smart decision': Elon Musk calls former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang 'irreplaceable'
item.description: Elon Musk has criticised Jensen Huang's exit from Nvidia, comparing the former CEO to Michael Jordan and saying removing him from the chipmaker was not a smart decision as he would be difficult to replace.

item.title: Amitabh Bachchan’s KBC question, Saif Ali Khan’s reaction: How Gowardhan Ghee found its new face
item.description: Saif Ali Khan has been named brand ambassador for Gowardhan Ghee, two years after winning a two-year supply on Kaun Banega Crorepati. The prize became a social media sensation, prompting the brand to turn the public’s interest into a marketing partnership.

item.title: Can your laptop do what Deepinder Goyal’s ₹85,000 Temple device does? Man’s experiment gets Zomato founder’s attention
item.description: A venture capital employee partially recreated Zomato co-founder Deepinder Goyal’s microphone-free Temple technology using his laptop’s accelerometer.&nbsp;

item.title: Intel lands first 18A chip customer, takes on TSMC: Who is its first chip customer? Apple, Nvidia in focus
item.description: Intel says it has signed its first external customer for its 18A-P chipmaking process, a milestone in its bid to compete with TSMC. The customer remains unnamed, while Apple, Nvidia, Amazon, Microsoft and Google are among potential clients seeking additional chipmaking capacity.

item.title: 'I would have spent less money': Elon Musk calls $400 million Republican campaign spending 'pretty foolish'
item.description: Elon Musk has said that he regrets spending over $400 million backing Republican candidates after the party suffered electoral setbacks in the US midterm elections, admitting that his political spending failed to deliver the expected results.
